tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search Sophia Commons for anthroposophical organizations: Waldorf schools, biodynamic farms, Camphill communities, The Christian Community, clinics, eurythmy, study groups and more. Combine a free-text query with category, country and city filters.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find anthroposophical organizations closest to a point, sorted by distance. Use the latitude and longitude of a town or address.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full public details of one directory listing by its id (from search_directory or find_nearby).

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming anthroposophical events listed on Sophia Commons: conferences, courses, talks, festivals, workshops and online study groups, soonest first.
